pilot_wave.purpose: Validate migration tooling, network routing, landing zone, and operational monitoring on low-risk workloads.
criteria: Non-production or internal IT workloads only

affinity_grouping.purpose: Cluster servers with high network flow volume into identical waves to eliminate cross-environment latency.

regulated_workloads.purpose: Isolate PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or sovereign data into dedicated landing-zone spokes with mandatory security sign-off.
regulated_workloads.sequencing: Execute in later waves after platform governance and security monitoring are proven stable.
